transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we're here to discuss the proposed centralized cash-pooling arrangement for our six operating entities. I have the authority to approve the rollout and set its operating conditions, but before we proceed to final authorization, I want to make sure we've covered all the necessary bases. Per our standard treasury approval process, I'll need confirmations from legal entity management, treasury operations, financial systems, and compliance. Let's start hearing from each of those areas. Who would like to begin?

transcript.text: I need to flag an important issue before we proceed. I received an entity-law memorandum this morning confirming that E4 cannot participate in the proposed cash pool. E4's local borrowing and security restrictions prohibit the required cross-guarantee, so E4 must be excluded from the arrangement. I should note that this memorandum has not yet been attached to the approval packet, so we'll need to make sure it's included before final authorization is recorded.
